findings.title: Preview discards the device timezone
findings.why_it_matters: The configurator preview still shows the forecast update in the spot timezone whenever the installer and spot are in different zones. The normalized forecast now carries `deviceTimezone`, but this downstream formatter recomputes the label from the older `timezone` field, so the two display paths disagree in normal remote-spot usage. Formatting from `deviceTimezone` makes the preview follow the same explicit contract as the firmware.
findings.suggested_fix: In `formatUpdatedTime`, require and pass `forecast.deviceTimezone` to `Intl.DateTimeFormat` instead of `forecast.timezone`, and add a screen-texture test where the device is `America/New_York`, the spot is `Europe/Amsterdam`, and the expected update hour is device-local.
evidence: web/tests/screen-texture.test.js:196 -- it('formats the update time from one timestamp using the selected clock', () => {

testing_gaps: Firmware host tests verify device-timezone persistence and migration but do not exercise `render_dashboard` with device and spot timezones that differ; the ESP build is the only coverage of that integration path.
